findings.finding: The $100m Aegis at-the-market facility (sales agreement 2026-04-15, shelf declared effective 2026-05-13) is open and can sell stock on 2026-09-28. The issuer's stated plan is to fund operations through ATM equity, and it has $1.4m of cash against a $12.9m working-capital deficit.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM sells on every trading day, so 2026-09-28 is a sale day. The need is dated and unmet: a $1.0m note instalment falls due 2026-10-23, and the issuer has already used this route, with shares up from 547,534 to 933,509 between 2026-06-30 and 2026-08-19.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In the dilution regime since 2026-08-18 this name had 12 comparable falls. 9 were followed by a lower next close, median -8.46% (-8.32, -4.25, -4.83, -8.59, -18.79, -13.83, -12.96, -8.89, -9.06 against +8.67, +3.86, +7.8), per the sealed baseline. Over 3 years, n=169, the median is only -0.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: The price holds the dilution already done, but an ATM is a flow and the close only discounts the share count to date. If the market held the future supply, the slide would have stopped repeating session after session. Instead, 9 of the last 12 comparable falls were followed by another down close. Today's fall also had no news of its own, which fits steady selling rather than a one-off repricing.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-15 short-interest settlement shows 3.65m average daily volume against 933,509 shares outstanding at 08-19, turnover several times the share count, which fits continuous issuance (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/DBGI/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). The 2026-07-24 8-K adds a $3.53m convertible note paying $1.0m on 2026-10-23, which dates the cash need (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1668010/000149315226034517/form8-k.htm).

outside_window.finding: The 60-day go-shop on the non-binding $77.58/share cash proposal from an unnamed existing shareholder ends 2026-10-05. Spot of $4.67 implies the market gives the proposal near-zero credibility. A definitive agreement would be a large positive; lapsing without one would be a modest negative. Sized as a small positive expectation with very high variance.
First $1.0m instalment on the $3.53m convertible note is due 2026-10-23. Failure to pay is an event of default and makes the note convertible at 90% of the lowest 5-day close.

The $100m equity line (2026-07-23) required an S-1 within 15 days and effectiveness within 75 days of closing, which is about 2026-10-06. No S-1 appears in EDGAR through 2026-09-25, so ELOC resale supply is not yet registered.
